title: Level 1 Mastery: Python for AI Agents
description: Evaluate your proficiency in Python fundamentals, Pydantic validation, async tool execution, and error handling for autonomous agents.

questions.question: Why is Pydantic preferred over standard dictionaries when handling structured outputs from LLMs?
options: It makes API calls 10x faster automatically
It validates data types, handles schema coercion, and generates OpenAPI JSON schemas
It encrypts prompt inputs to prevent prompt injection
It replaces the need for virtual environments
questions.explanation: Pydantic enforces strict type contracts, coerces compatible values, and provides .model_json_schema() which is sent directly to LLMs for structured tool/function calling.

questions.question: What is the primary risk of omitting a hard iteration limit in an autonomous agent while-loop?
options: Python will throw a SyntaxError immediately
The script will deplete memory and fail to import
The agent could enter an infinite loop, draining API credits and locking server resources
The LLM context window will automatically expand without cost
questions.explanation: If the agent fails to reach its stop condition or gets stuck in a repetitive loop, it can rack up hundreds of dollars in API costs in minutes without a strict max_iterations guard.

questions.question: When defining tools for LLMs, what is the critical role of the Python function docstring?
options: It is ignored by LLM SDKs and only read by developers
It serves as the natural language prompt that instructs the LLM what the tool does and when to invoke it
It compiles the Python code into C bytecode for faster execution
It registers the function in the operating system PATH
questions.explanation: LLM tool-calling APIs extract function docstrings and parameter annotations to explain the tool's behavior and argument schema to the language model.

questions.question: Which asyncio method should you use to execute 5 independent search API calls simultaneously?
options: asynci✅wait_forever()
asynci✅sleep()
asynci✅gather()
asynci✅thread_lock()
questions.explanation: synci✅gather(*tasks) schedules multiple coroutines concurrently on the event loop and returns when all have finished.

questions.question: What should an agent tool do when it encounters an external API timeout?
options: Raise an unhandled exception to crash the entire application
Catch the timeout and return an actionable observation string for the LLM to decide the next step
Silently pass and return None without telling the model
Delete the chat history database
questions.explanation: In agent design, tool failures are observations. Returning an informative error string lets the model understand what went wrong and choose an alternative action.
